verdict.rationale: Riskified is a fraud-decisioning platform, so an analyst-authored rules engine is a fair axis. The evidence only shows Riskified itself returning approve/decline/review or allow/notify/challenge decisions from its own models, which its analytics team calibrates. Nothing documents merchant analysts writing custom rules that combine model scores, velocity counters, list matches or transaction attributes.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, I can author custom rules that combine model scores, velocity counters, list matches, and transaction attributes into allow, block, or review decisions
